entries.08d248144acf5ebb: The company is a standalone entity with no subsidiaries or affiliates. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is 259.
entries.0bc704bfdf98d206: Its distinctive structure is that it handles everything in-house, from rearing day-old chicks and producing eggs to manufacturing at its GP plant and direct sales to customers. Its henhouses in Hokkaido have a windowless structure that prevents the entry of wild animals, and safety measures are advanced through fully automated management and Salmonella vaccination. Specialty eggs enriched with nutrients account for a high proportion of sales, and the company also provides OEM supply of private-brand products by customer.

entries.460cde43bb5a083e: This is a single-segment business that produces and sells eggs. It consists of production operations (raising and producing laying hens at 5 company-owned farms for mature hens in Hokkaido and 3 farms in Tohoku), manufacturing operations (sorting and packaging at 5 GP plants in Hokkaido and 3 GP plants in Tohoku certified under FSSC22000, and production of liquid egg and hot-spring egg at the Wattsu liquid egg plant), and sales operations (direct sales in Hokkaido without wholesalers, expansion of direct sales in Tohoku through branches, and exports to the Hong Kong market). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,107 million.
